title: ELANG IPA Repertoire v1
description: Strict JSON Schema for the ELANG IPA repertoire v1. This schema defines the SHAPE only. The approved symbol inventories themselves are an OPEN ARTIFACT (T0106-T0110) and MUST be produced from the pinned 2026 IPA chart and reviewed before use; this schema embeds no symbols. See docs/open-artifacts.md and ADR 0003.

repertoire_version.description: Repertoire schema/content version. Fixed at 1 for this schema.

unicode_version.description: Pinned Unicode Standard version the data was validated against.

ipa_chart.description: Pinned IPA chart issue the inventory derives from.

base_symbols.description: Approved IPA base symbols. Unique and sorted (see json-encoding-policy.md). Empty until the inventory is ratified.

combining_diacritics.description: Approved IPA combining diacritics. Unique and sorted.

spacing_modifiers.description: Approved IPA spacing modifier letters. Unique and sorted.

symbol.description: The NFC string form of the symbol (one or more Unicode scalar values).

codepoints.description: Ordered list of Unicode scalar values composing the NFC symbol, as U+XXXX uppercase-hex strings.

name.description: Optional Unicode character name or IPA description for human review.
